svg.aria-label: The Studio 3D view of ies-core.ttl. Grey edges a person asserted, green edges the engine derived and Lean accepted, one red edge forged and refused, one amber question returned unasked because its subject is a concept and not a class, with the verification layer drawn as nodes.
